::: {#rem-iteration-guess}
#### Iteration gives a guess

In @exm-double-plus-power-iteration, the formula for general $k$ came from the three cases $k = 1, 2, 3$.
Nothing proved that the pattern continues, so the closed form $b_n = n \cdot 2^n$ is still a guess.
Induction (@def-proof-by-induction) turns such a guess into a theorem,
with the recurrence relation in the inductive step.

:::
